2126614519170339133.en_summary: France's long end still pays a lot. On Friday's last quotes the 30-year gap over Germany was 162 basis points, while the 10-year gap was near 143 to 145 depending on the source, so lenders want roughly 18 to 20 basis points more for the extra two decades. The easing Robin shows in the 10-year fits oil's slide since 30 October. Monday has a new test, though: S&P moved France's outlook to negative after Friday's close, citing bigger deficits and political polarization. And INSEE's national accounts chief says France has been in a technical recession since the second quarter, which leaves Paris with weaker growth and higher funding costs at the same time.
2126614519170339133.zh_summary: 法國長端仍支付很多。上週五最後報價30年期相對德國利差為162個基點，而10年期利差接近143至145個基點（視來源），因此貸款人要求額外二十年大約多18至20個基點。Robin在10年期顯示的緩解符合自10月30日以來油價下滑。然而週一有新測試：標普在週五收盤後將法國展望調至負面，理由是更大赤字與政治極化。INSEE國民帳戶主管稱法國自第二季以來處於技術性衰退，使巴黎同時面對較弱增長與較高融資成本。
